gui.hearthstead.permissions.title: Permissions
gui.hearthstead.permissions.owner_only: Only the owner can change permissions. Officers can always do everything.
gui.hearthstead.permissions.action.break: break blocks in the colony (hut blocks always need an officer)
gui.hearthstead.permissions.action.build: place blocks and change them with items (hoes, axes, buckets, bone meal, ...)

hurt citizens and animals in the colony

gui.hearthstead.updates.title: Automatic Updates
gui.hearthstead.updates.question: Hearthstead can look for new releases on GitHub when the game starts and put them into your mods folder. A new version is installed when you close the game and used from the next start.
gui.hearthstead.updates.change: You can change this later in config/hearthstead.toml (automaticUpdates).
toast.hearthstead.update_ready.detail: It is installed when you close the game.

research.hearthstead.community_spirit.de: Festivals and shared work bring the settlers together: +1 happiness for every citizen.
research.hearthstead.comfortable_homes.d: Better furniture makes room for one more resident in every built Residence.
research.hearthstead.feast_days.desc: Hearty, regular meals: citizens get hungry 30% more slowly.
research.hearthstead.apprenticeship.desc: Experienced workers teach the young: all citizens work 10% faster.
Scaffolding and better planning: builders place blocks about 40% faster.
research.hearthstead.master_craftsmen.de: Guild knowledge passed down: all citizens work a further 15% faster.
research.hearthstead.militia_drills.desc: Daily sword practice: guards deal 2 more damage.
Guards learn to fight in mail: +4 armour for every guard.
research.hearthstead.stone_walls.desc: Walls and watchtowers deter attackers: raids are 25% smaller.
research.hearthstead.spacious_homes.desc: Bunk beds and an extra room: one more resident in every built Residence.
research.hearthstead.golden_age.desc: A thriving, proud colony: +1 happiness for every citizen.
research.hearthstead.herbal_remedies.des: Poultices and herb gardens: well-fed citizens heal twice as fast.
research.hearthstead.welcome_wagons.desc: Word of the colony spreads: new settlers arrive twice as often while there are free beds.
research.hearthstead.market_days.desc: A market square draws traders: wandering merchants visit three times as often.
research.hearthstead.delivery_carts.desc: Handcarts for the deliverymen: they walk 30% faster.
research.hearthstead.masterwork.desc: The finest tools and techniques: all citizens work a further 20% faster.
research.hearthstead.bountiful_harvest.d: Crop rotation and good seed: farmers get one extra crop from a quarter of their harvests.
research.hearthstead.skilled_lumberjacks: Sharper axes and better technique: lumberjacks fell trees about a third faster.
research.hearthstead.prospectors.desc: Miners learn to follow the veins: one in five ores they mine gives an extra drop.
research.hearthstead.plate_armor.desc: Smiths forge plate for the guard: +6 more armour for every guard.
research.hearthstead.fortified_colony.de: Gates, towers and a ditch: raids are another 25% smaller and come half as often.
research.hearthstead.first_aid.desc: Bandages and a field surgeon: guards have 10 more health.
research.hearthstead.swift_patrols.desc: Light boots and short routes: guards move 20% faster.
research.hearthstead.veteran_guards.desc: Years of service show: guards deal 3 more damage.
gui.hearthstead.research.missing_items: The University is missing the required materials
